# System Reference Document 5.1 attribution

This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1
("SRD 5.1") by Wizards of the Coast LLC and available at
https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. The SRD 5.1 is
licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License
available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.

The licensed source reviewed for this baseline is
https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf.
The full CC-BY-4.0 legal text, including its warranty disclaimer and limitation
of liability, is retained with the offline notices and at
`third-party/sources/CC-BY-4.0.txt`.

Changes include conversion to Aurora XML, indexing, summaries and adaptations
for character calculations. Compatibility identifiers may retain historical
source abbreviations. Original Aurora Lights application code remains under
MIT; the SRD-derived material retains its CC-BY-4.0 terms.

This attribution applies to verified SRD portions. It does not establish a grant
for non-SRD content, artwork, logos, unrelated fonts or files whose scope review
is still pending. The release checks remain closed until the bundled baseline
migration and its review are complete. The historical OGL notice is preserved
separately; it is not the redistribution basis claimed for the new verified
CC-BY-4.0 baseline.
